question: What must be broken before you can use it?
I have keys but I open no locks. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
What goes up but never comes down?
What has hands but cannot clap?
What has one eye but cannot see?
What has a neck but no head?
I have rivers but no water, forests but no trees. What am I?
I follow you all day, but in the dark I am gone. What am I?
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
I am full of holes but I can still hold water. What am I?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
I get shorter the longer I live. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and answer when you shout in the jungle. What am I?
I have keys and space, but no rooms. What am I?
